_notice: FICTITIOUS. Adverse event reports about a product that does not exist, from patients, caregivers and prescribers who do not exist. Phone numbers use the reserved 555-01xx range. Scenario-author material; keep the expected assessments out of generator and judge prompts.
usage: Each report is what reached Arden Quay Biosciences, with the chain of receipts. receipts[].by is the channel that received the information; criteria_complete says whether all four minimum criteria were present by then. expected is the correct intake assessment under safety/safety-reference.json: day_0 is the first receipt with criteria_complete true; due is day_0 + 15 calendar days for a serious, unlisted adverse event; internal_forward_late is true when Drug Safety received the report more than 1 business day after the first receipt. ref links to ps-conversations.json, hcp-inbound.json or crm/call-log.json.

reports.title: Stomach pain mentioned while asking about a refill
reports.report: Forwarded transcript, QuorvantaConnect assistant, 2026-09-21. Caller verified as Rupert Ekwueme-Soto, case QC-26-00119: "Rupert Ekwueme-Soto, born November 29, 1970, ZIP 21201. I haven't been able to call the pharmacy back because I've been in bed with bad stomach pain since last week." The assistant gave the adverse event handoff and case information. No further details were collected.

events.verbatim: bad stomach pain since last week

follow_up: whether he has seen a healthcare provider or been admitted to the hospital

reports.title: Black stools reported to the HCP chatbot, then by phone
reports.report: HCP chatbot, 2026-09-14, unauthenticated session: "My patient on QUORVANTA has had black stools since yesterday. What should I do?" The chatbot gave the adverse event handoff. Drug Safety call, 2026-09-15, Dr. Leopold Ybarra-Finch, Juniper Mesa Clinic, Albuquerque: "I'm calling about the patient I asked your website about yesterday. She's a 42-year-old woman who started QUORVANTA in June. Black, tarry stools for two days; I sent her to the emergency department and she was admitted last night for an endoscopy."

events.verbatim: black, tarry stools for two days

tests: day 0 is when the last minimum criterion arrived
